title: The Basket of Summer Fruit

questions.question: What did the Lord God show Amos in the vision in chapter 8?
questions.explanation: Amos 8:1 (ESV): "This is what the Lord God showed me: behold, a basket of summer fruit."

questions.question: God said, "The end has come upon my people Israel; I will never again..."?
questions.explanation: Amos 8:2 (ESV): "I will never again pass by them."

questions.question: Those who trample on the needy and bring the poor of the land to an end say, "When will the new moon be over, that we may sell..."?
questions.explanation: Amos 8:5 (ESV): "When will the new moon be over, that we may sell grain?"

questions.question: The Lord has sworn by the pride of Jacob: "Surely I will never forget any of their..."?
questions.explanation: Amos 8:7 (ESV): "Surely I will never forget any of their deeds."

questions.question: "Behold, the days are coming," declares the Lord God, "when I will send a famine on the land; not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of..."?
options: Hearing the words of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Hearing the words of the Lord
questions.explanation: Amos 8:11 (ESV): "but of hearing the words of the Lord."

questions.question: The songs of the temple shall become what in that day?
questions.explanation: Amos 8:3 (ESV): "The songs of the temple shall become wailings in that day,"

questions.question: So many dead bodies! They are thrown everywhere. Silence!
questions.explanation: Amos 8:3 (ESV): "So many dead bodies! They are thrown everywhere. Silence!"

questions.question: They make the ephah small and the shekel great and deal deceitfully with false what?
questions.explanation: Amos 8:5 (ESV): "making the ephah small and the shekel great and dealing deceitfully with false balances,"

questions.question: I will make the sun go down at what time?
questions.explanation: Amos 8:9 (ESV): "I will make the sun go down at noon and darken the earth in broad daylight."

questions.question: I will turn your feasts into mourning and all your songs into what?
questions.explanation: Amos 8:10 (ESV): "I will turn your feasts into mourning and all your songs into lamentation;"

questions.question: I will make it like the mourning for an only son, and the end of it like a what day?
questions.explanation: Amos 8:10 (ESV): "and the end of it like a bitter day."

questions.question: They shall wander from sea to sea, and from north to east; they shall run to and fro, to seek the word of the Lord, but they shall not what?
questions.explanation: Amos 8:12 (ESV): "but they shall not find it."

questions.question: In that day the lovely virgins and the young men shall faint for what?
questions.explanation: Amos 8:13 (ESV): "In that day the lovely virgins and the young men shall faint for thirst."

questions.question: Those who swear by the Guilt of Samaria, and say, "As your god lives, O Dan," and, "As the Way of... lives," they shall fall, and never rise again.
questions.explanation: Amos 8:14 (ESV): "'As the Way of Beersheba lives,' they shall fall, and never rise again."

questions.question: Shall not the land tremble on this account, and everyone mourn who dwells in it, and all of it rise like what?
questions.explanation: Amos 8:8 (ESV): "and all of it rise like the Nile, and be tossed about and sink again, like the Nile of Egypt?"

key_verse_text: "Behold, the days are coming," declares the Lord God, "when I will send a famine on the land; not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord."
